mainDesc: Dump source after <value> stage. Supported value: parse, desugared-parse, macro, sema, desugared-sema.
Pass config file name, default: passes.json.
Enable macro when <value> is true. Supported <value>: (default) true, false.

subDesc.desc: Do macro expansion, please ensure the runtime and macro libs are in CANGJIE_HOME.
Skip macro expansions when no macro using.

mainDesc: Dump desugared code when <value> is true. Supported <value>: (default) true, false.

Only check syntax errors of input when <value> is true, skip analysis and conversion. Input can be a .cj file or a directory. For a directory, each sub-directory that directly contains .cj files is treated as one package and checked per package (avoids missed errors when multi-package files are mixed in one frontend invocation). Supported <value>: (default) false, true.

subDesc.desc: Parse the input file(s) and report syntax errors, then exit early (no ast dump / analysis / conversion). A directory input is walked recursively and grouped per package (each directory directly containing .cj files), each package checked in its own frontend invocation. No need to pass --dump-source.
Run the full pipeline as normal.

mainDesc: Filter top-level decls of <value>. Supported <value>: func, var, struct, enum, interface, class
Ignore top-level decls whoes identifier is <value>.
Pass the task config file name.
Run tasks in parallel with <value> threads.
